I can’t use a microphone or speakers directly here — this chat is text-only.

If you want, I can still help in a more voice-like way:
- keep responses short and conversational
- help you draft something to read aloud
- format replies for speech apps
- simulate a back-and-forth conversation

If you’re using an app or device with speech-to-text / text-to-speech, I can also help you set up a workflow for that.
